item.title: A message from Mrs. Longval:
item.description: Are you ready to dodge, duck, dive and make a difference! Our annual Movember Dodgeball Tournament is happening next Wednesday, November 25, in support of men's health initiatives! Grades 9–12, it's time to get your teams together! Registration forms are located outside Mrs. Longval's office. Spaces are limited, so don't wait to sign up! Grades 7 & 8, your tournament will take place during Periods 1 and 2 next Wednesday. Mr. Benoit will be organizing your teams, so please see him to register or if you have any questions. 📢Did you know that men are often less likely to talk openly about their mental health or reach out for support when they're struggling? That's one of the reasons Movember is so important! It's about starting conversations, breaking down barriers and reminding the men and boys in our lives that mental health matters just as much as physical health. All STA staff and students are encouraged to support this important cause by making a donation. SchoolCash Online donations will be set up early next week, making it easy for everyone to contribute. Every donation, big or small, can make a difference! Let's come together as a school community, have some fun, show our school spirit and support men's health! Don't dodge the fun, STA! Get your teams registered and let's make a difference! Please chat with Mrs. Longval if you have any questions!
